title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Sequel
description: A continuation of Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint following the events of the original 551-chapter web novel. The side story expands upon the aftermath of the main story and introduces Lee Hakhyun as its central character, while continuing to explore the worldlines, characters, and mysteries left behind by the original story. It serves as a continuation of the original novel rather than a separate unrelated spin-off.
author: Sing Shong
